description: This PHP source file defines a class 'AdministrationViewGlobalsearchsettings' that extends 'SugarView' and handles the display and configuration of global search settings within the SuiteCRM Administration module. It includes methods for setting page titles, module tabs, and rendering the settings interface, primarily via Smarty templates.

classes.name: AdministrationViewGlobalsearchsettings
classes.description: A class extending SugarView responsible for displaying and managing global search settings in the SuiteCRM admin interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array representing the module title parameters, including a link to the Administration index and the global search settings label.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the string 'Administration' indicating the current module tab.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the global search settings page by preparing Smarty template variables, retrieving enabled and disabled modules, and fetches the corresponding template to display.
